description: 2% Salicylic Acid Gel for Acne with 1% Glycolic Acid & 4% Niacinamide Reduces Pimples/Acne & Inflammation (Redness): The Salicylic Acid in this gel fights acne-causing bacteria, dries out current pimples, and reduces overall visible inflammation. Exfoliates Dead Skin Cells: The formulation of Glycolic Acid and Salicylic Acid (AHA & BHA) in this acne clearing gel gently but effectively exfoliates the skin to prevent further acne and improves the overall appearance of acne-prone skin. Minimizes Pores: This gel helps unclog your pores by removing the dead skin cells and oil trapped in them to improve the appearance of pores. Reduces chances of acne scarring: When applied on active acne - this gel reduces the chances of Post-Inflammatory Hyperpigmentation (PIH) as the ingredients work to calm the acne and reduce it For best results, use the 2% Salicylic Acid Gel for 2 months. ⚠️Always follow it up with a broad-spectrum sunscreen during the day to avoid sun damage. 30 gms | Lasts one month Although our products are made with utmost care and rigorously tested - none of our bodies are the same!

list.content:
Patch tests are an easy way to make sure you don't experience any initial negative reaction when using a new product. We recommend doing a patch test prior to starting any new product on your skin. You can conduct a patch test by following the below steps:
1. Apply the product to a small patch of skin either to the arm or bend of the elbow
2. Keep the area dry
3. Leave on for 12-24 hours (or lesser if the product isn’t a leave-on product)
4. If any redness, itching or irritation is observed at any time during the test do not use the product, else you can safely use it

list.title: How does this 2% Salicylic Acid Gel work in reducing acne?
list.content: Glycolic acid (AHA) and salicylic acid (BHA) help in exfoliating the skin and reducing sebum production. Niacinamide fades acne spots and scars while arginine repairs your skin.

list.title: Is this Salicylic acid gel ideal for all skin types?
list.content: Yes, it can be used with combination skin, dry skin, oily skin, sensitive skin and normal skin. Use it once a day if you have dry skin.This gel helps in reducing acne size and redness.

list.title: Does this clearing gel act as an exfoliant?
list.content: Yes, as it contains Glycolic acid (AHA), which helps in exfoliation.

list.title: What is the role of salicylic acid (BHA) in this 2% Salicylic Acid Gel?
list.content: Salicylic acid (BHA) helps get rid of excessive sebum (oil) on the face. It is a potent anti-inflammatory ingredient that is powerful in treating acne quickly.

list.title: What is the efficacy of this Acne Gel?
list.content: This product begins to show effect within the first week. It is beneficial in clearing active acne and inflammation as well as controls oiliness.

list.title: What is the dosage of this 2% Salicylic Acid Gel?
list.content: Apply 0.5 ml (pea-size) of the gel twice a day to the affected area once your face is dry. Vary dosage and spot-apply  if you are using another leave-on acne treatment

list.title: Are there any side effects of this Salicylic acid gel for acne?
list.content: This gel may cause minor dryness. Reduce usage to once a day if excessive dryness or peeling occurs. Do not apply on cuts, sunburnt or abraded skin. Allow to dry before applying any additional products. Do not use with retinol based products. Spot-apply if you are using another leave-on acne treatment
